attachment.$description: A file or image row — the third piece of the Message/Bubble/Attachment family (see the approved plan at ~/.claude/plans/distributed-sprouting-gadget.md), used both in a composer (pre-send, with a remove/cancel action) and in message display (post-send, a real link/download). One BASE size for display; the idle/uploading shapes additionally get a `compact` pre-send chip density (see compact.$description) — not a full sm/base/lg ladder, and the done row stays single-size per Card/Menu/Popover reasoning. Two media variants: 'icon' (insert_drive_file.svg in a raised surface.default square — the 'icon in a soft square' pattern noted back in the very first Vercel-reference session and never used until now) for non-image files, 'image' (a real ``, object-fit:cover, filling the media box edge to edge) for image attachments. Only 3 states, matching the real product need, not shadcn's full idle/uploading/processing/error/done set: **idle** (just attached, ready to send — remove action), **uploading** (in progress — description swaps to 'Uploading · NN%', same remove action doubles as cancel), **done** (already sent — the whole row becomes a real ``, download affordance, no separate nested button to avoid an interactive-inside-interactive anti-pattern). No error state yet — not a real need seen in the driving screenshots, revisit if one appears. No AttachmentGroup (horizontally-scrollable multi-file row) — that's a composition of several Attachments plus a flex-wrap/scroll container, not a new token file, same pattern as Pagination's 'full bar'.

compact.$description: Pre-send chip density for the idle/uploading shapes — the composer context (compose dialog + in-thread reply), added 2026-08-03; reshaped same day per user review from a 32px single-line chip to taller-but-NARROWER: the component's own two-line text stack (12px semibold title over the 10px size line) at a 160px maxWidth, inline 16px icon instead of the 40px media box, 4px vertical padding (~36px tall). Chips hug content and sit in ONE nowrap row with horizontal overflow (rowGap) — pre-send files are transient dismissible input, per the Gmail-attachment-chip / messenger-thumbnail-row convention — unlike the informative full-width row a SENT message displays: the done shape deliberately has no compact variant.

media.$description: 40px (dim.10) — same box size as Avatar's own base size, so an Attachment and an Avatar line up when both sit in a message row. iconBg (surface.default, white) sitting inside the card's own surface.sunken (gray) reads as a subtle raised inset — the exact 'icon-in-a-soft-square' treatment flagged as worth reusing back when Vercel's own post-deploy screen was noted as a reference, first real use of it.

action.$description: The trailing remove/cancel button (idle/uploading only) — resolved from Popover/Drawer/Modal's own close-button recipe, not re-invented.

done.$description: Post-send — the whole row becomes a real <a>, hover/focus reuse Card's own hairline-hover-to-brand-blue language rather than inventing a new one.
